Four Kings picked DM2. The game took a while to get going, finding a server, but once that had been done the game started. Within minutes all of FF timed. The match restarted with 4K getting a good start and holding the lead for a few minutes. FF tried to come back and grab the quad but 4K beat off the early attacks and headed out to a large lead (nearing 100-10 ish). FF started a comeback, and managed to take control over the low rl. However any attacks on the quad were failing and so 4K managed to keep the lead. Towards the end FF finally managed to take the quad area, securing the level and racking up frags but it was too late. / 4K^Kara.

=== DM3 === 4K: 131 - DN: 82

[https://www.quakeworld.nu/w/images/6/6e/4k_vs_ff_dm3-zombeh.qwd Demo by Zombeh]
The map for the decider was the remaining map in the pool. A nice match, though hampered by lag. 4K makes a good start but one of their players disconnects a few minutes into the game. FF apparently does not take full advantage of this and 4K fights on, increasing their lead. Then as Gun gets into the game with around seven minutes left the Swedes are paralyzed quite literally as their connections get bogged. 4K takes full control but FF fights back with a vengeance and rack up quite a number of frags towards the end of the game. / ego == Summary == * Score: 2-1 * Total frags ** 4K: 452 ** FF: 370 __NOTOC__ [[Category:Matchreports]]
